thread:
alex_kr: Quick sync — tentative milestone change: v2 deprecation announcement moved to Apr 14. Need alignment on SDK GA, server fallbacks, and docs. Who's picking up which piece?

maria_g: I can own the SDK release (0.9.0). Plan: open RC on Apr 6, RC validation through Apr 9, GA Apr 11 if no regressions. @ryan_t can you confirm server-side fallback readiness?

ryan_t: Routing fallback PR was merged to canary yesterday. I'll run a load sweep Apr 9; if green we'll start staggered rollout Apr 11. Need SDK compatibility tests for: streaming, function-calls, and header format.

olivia: I'll take docs/migration guide. Target to have the guide + examples by Apr 8. Need sample app PRs to illustrate header changes. @samir can you do a quick review on the migration wording?

samir: Yep — I'll review docs. Quick note: grpc-lib 2.1.0 changed header parsing behavior; eng-runtime should validate this against v2 header expectations. Example validation snippet: 
```http
POST /v2/generate
Content-Type: application/json
X-Client-Version: 0.9.0-rc
```

deploy-bot: CI update: nightly canary runs will include the v2-compat matrix starting Apr 6. Failures will auto-open tracking issues.

maria_g: For QA matrix I propose we run tests across: 0.8.x (current), 0.9.0-rc, and v2-preview server. I'll open a tracking issue with explicit test cases (streaming, function args, header parsing).

alex_kr: Ownership recap so it's explicit: SDK release -> maria_g; routing + canary rollout -> ryan_t; docs/migration guide -> olivia; QA/regressions -> samir; runtime validation -> eng-runtime team. If anyone objects or wants to swap, speak now.

ryan_t: Sounds good. One operational question: if canary uncovers a compatibility regression, should we pause SDK GA or rollout a server-side patch first? My preference: patch server and hold SDK GA until RC is clean.

maria_g: I agree. We'll keep the GA gated on canary results. If we must change client behavior, we'll cut 0.9.1 and update migration notes.

olivia: Tiny logistics: the deprecation notice copy needs to include quick migration snippets (curl + SDK example). Draft is at https://redwood-internal/docs/v2-deprec-draft — comments welcome.

samir: I'll wire up e2e alerts in the infra dashboard and add a PagerDuty runbook for a compatibility regression so on-call knows steps to triage.

alex_kr: Great — I'll assemble a short one-pager with dates, owners, and the gating checklist and post to #eng-releases by EOD. Ping me if you hit blockers. :thumbsup:
